description.value: Long's Noodle (上海小籠記) is a family-run Shanghainese restaurant operated by couple Long and Sandy S., who have been serving the Lower Mainland since opening on Vancouver's Main Street in 2001. Now located in Richmond, it bills itself as the Lower Mainland's best Shanghainese restaurant with a focus on fresh ingredients and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. A touring cyclist riding Richmond's flat cycling network would find it a convenient stop for a sit-down Shanghainese meal.

address.value: 4731 Garden City Rd #140, Richmond, BC V6X 3M7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a real, operating Shanghainese restaurant at the OSM address (4731 Garden City Rd #140, Richmond) and corroborates the phone number. A temporary closure notice (April 13–May 12, 2026 annual staff trip) was posted, but operations were stated to resume May 13, 2026, so the business is open as of today (May 28, 2026). Neither the website nor OSM tags mention any cyclist-specific amenities, so all amenity fields default to null.
